question: Using data from both the regular season and the post-season, identify the pitcher who achieved the highest non-zero pitch speed for each team by confirming whether the pitcher’s ID appears in the relevant home or away player lists for that game, then retrieve that pitcher’s full name along with the maximum valid pitch speed they achieved while playing for that specific team.
sql:
WITH lineup_teams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT gameId, lineupTeamId as teamId, lineupPlayerId as playerId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  WHERE inningEventType = 'LINEUP'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT gameId, lineupTeamId as teamId, lineupPlayerId as playerId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
  WHERE inningEventType = 'LINEUP'
),
pitch_data AS (
  SELECT gameId, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed, 
         awayTeamId, homeTeamId, awayTeamName, homeTeamName
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  WHERE pitchSpeed > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gameId, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed, 
         awayTeamId, homeTeamId, awayTeamName, homeTeamName
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
  WHERE pitchSpeed > 0
),
matched AS (
  SELECT p.gameId, p.pitcherId, p.pitcherFirstName, p.pitcherLastName, p.pitchSpeed,
         lt.teamId as teamId
  FROM pitch_data p
  JOIN lineup_teams lt ON p.gameId = lt.gameId AND p.pitcherId = lt.playerId
),
team_pitcher_max AS (
  SELECT teamId, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, MAX(pitchSpeed) as max_speed
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY teamId, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName
)
SELECT teamId, COUNT(*) as num_tied, MAX(max_speed) as top_speed
FROM team_pitcher_max
GROUP BY teamId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY teamId
